_doc: The conduit crawler's surfaces (docs/kb/art/creatures/act2/conduit_crawler.md). Slots are the glTF material names; write_materials.py writes assets/creatures/conduit_crawler/materials/<slot>.tres on game/shaders/creature/creature.gdshader. shell is the salt-glass dome, glossy, whose emission mask is the glow of the bound light inside showing through its crown: glimmer_bound, steady, never pulsing (a Lit Age construct, creatures README rule 3; color_script.md rule 2); seam is the raised bead down its back where the shell's halves meet, the spawn_wound weak point with its slow weak-point pulse; frame is the brass going bronze_patina (the rim, the ribs, the belly plate, the legs and arms, by vertex colour), the lacquer_black joints and feet, the brush's sand_cloth bristles and the wiper's black blade, no emission. Colours are palette.json swatches.
